text:
lucy: heads up, cost spike on embed-route after we enabled broader sampling last night (~02:10 UTC). saw 2.6x internal token increase for some tenants.
omar: which flag? sampler.rate?
lucy: yes, 0.5% -> 3%. meant to improve dim histograms.
frank: expected side-effect: more mixed-dim batches surfaced -> splitter multiplies internal requests. we need guardrails.
pm-ela: product needs a short explainer for CS/Finance and mitigation steps.
omar: immediate mitigation: reduce global sample to 1% and exclude free-tier for 24h. who can flip?
frank: i'll flip canary now.
observability-bot: sampler rollback triggered (job id: 112233). posting results shortly.
frank: rollback completed. splitter invocations down ~55%, cost delta down ~40% vs peak.
lucy: short-term handled. long-term: propose a cheap estimator endpoint that predicts split probability and est_units WITHOUT invoking splitter.
omar: agree. estimator avoids multiplier side-effects of sampling. sketch: POST /v1/embeddings/estimate {num_inputs, avg_bytes, dims_hint} -> {est_units, prob_split, est_confidence}.
pm-ela: product wants estimator surfaced in console: "est. cost" line + "may fragment" badge when prob_split > 0.5; billing note during canary.
frank: telemetry: attach estimator_id to requests and sample predictions at 1% to compute accuracy; storage increase minimal.
omar: rollout: canary 10k requests in us-east, compare predictions vs actual splits; require precision >= 0.9 to widen.
lucy: add automation guard: if splitter_amplification > 2.0 within 2h of sampling-config-change, auto-revert sampler.rate. observability-bot, create alert.
observability-bot: alert rule created (id: O-4040).
pm-ela: follow-ups captured: OBS quota ticket, API PR draft, console mock, support note. thanks all.
